candidate.sink_summary: The X-Powered-By header is set based on the value of xpowered variable, which is derived from CONF.default_xpoweredby. If xpowered is truthy, it sets the header; otherwise, it deletes the header.
candidate.guard_summary: There are no explicit validation or sanitization controls for the default_xpoweredby configuration value before it's used to set the X-Powered-By header. The framework allows setting this value through configuration but doesn't validate its contents.
candidate.risk_pattern: The framework allows configuration of the X-Powered-By header value, which can reveal backend technology information to attackers. An attacker could potentially use this information for targeted attacks against known vulnerabilities in Total.js or related components.
